description: Tag routing transformation. Given a service name, a set of raw instance tags, a blacklist of tag patterns, and per-service allowed tag-combination rules, produce the set of tags usable for routing. Tags matching any blacklist pattern (full-match regex) are discarded. For a service with no combination rules only surviving single tags are emitted. For a service configured with two-tag combinations, additional joined 'a,b' tags are emitted for every surviving tag pair that matches an allowed pair of patterns (tags within a joined value are in ascending order). For a service configured with three-tag combinations, the joined two- and three-tag values for matching pattern groups are also emitted. When every raw tag is filtered out, the special line 'tags=none' is emitted instead. Output is one 'tag=<value>' line per resulting tag, sorted ascending.
